events.title: Level all, item tooltips, and a new storybook
events.summary: Two things you asked for, a new storybook, and a rat that had grown far too big. Level all A new Level all button sits beside the buy multiplier at the top right. It spends your gold one level at a time, always on the lowest-level hero in your party, so the whole party climbs together for as long as your gold lasts. events.title: Graphics settings, and a much faster room
events.summary: This update is all about performance: Quartermark now runs comfortably on older laptops, and faster on every PC. Graphics settings Settings → Display now has Graphics: Auto, Low, Medium and High. Auto, the default, looks at your graphics card the first time you start the game and picks the setting that suits it: High on a gaming PC, Medium or Low on a laptop. events.title: Four new heroes, a Weekly Gate, and every boss fighting like itself
events.summary: A big one. The full game gains four heroes and a hundred bosses that finally fight like the creatures they are; the demo gets the new systems, the fixes and every creature's own special attack. Four new heroes Stormcaller — Chain Lightning strikes every creature and pushes their attacks back, so a boss's special comes later. events.title: Ten bosses rebuilt, every hero worth playing, legendaries that mean something
events.summary: This update reworks how the first ten bosses fight, how your party is balanced, and how rare the best loot is. Everything below is already in the demo.
